categories.title: Architecture & governance
categories.summary: Start with business outcomes, shared responsibility, and a deliberate platform design.

categories.title: Identity & access
categories.summary: Use Microsoft Entra ID, least privilege, and secretless access.

categories.title: Cluster security
categories.summary: Harden the platform and enforce a measurable security baseline.

categories.title: Multi-tenancy & isolation
categories.summary: Match isolation boundaries to trust, ownership, and regulatory requirements.

categories.title: Networking & ingress
categories.summary: Design address space, private connectivity, ingress, and outbound dependencies.

categories.title: Storage & data
categories.summary: Choose durable storage deliberately and test how data survives disruption.

categories.title: Resources & scaling
categories.summary: Right-size workloads and scale nodes and applications without surprises.

categories.title: Cluster operations
categories.summary: Automate day-two work and make changes repeatable and recoverable.

categories.title: Lifecycle & retirements
categories.summary: Stay supported. Track Kubernetes, node operating systems, APIs, and add-ons.

categories.title: Observability & incident response
categories.summary: Connect metrics, logs, traces, and actionable alerts to service objectives.

categories.title: Reliability & disaster recovery
categories.summary: Validate availability, recovery objectives, backups, and regional failover.

categories.title: Windows workloads
categories.summary: Account for Windows-specific compatibility, identity, and operational constraints.

categories.title: Application delivery
categories.summary: Ship resilient workloads with safe rollouts and explicit runtime contracts.

categories.title: Images & supply chain
categories.summary: Build, verify, patch, and distribute trusted container artifacts.

categories.title: Cost & sustainability
categories.summary: Measure unit costs and balance efficiency with reliability and operational effort.

notices.title: Ingress migration is time-sensitive
notices.text: Upstream Ingress NGINX maintenance ended in March 2026. AKS application routing NGINX critical-security-patch support runs through November 2026. Plan and test a supported Gateway API migration now.

notices.title: Retired is not production-ready
notices.text: Replace Azure Linux 2.0, Windows Server 2019, and the retired pod-managed identity add-on. Upgrade Basic Load Balancer and Availability Sets. Migrate kubenet before 31 March 2028.
